app.name: Scholia
conversation.moveHint: A conversation moves only to a project protected at the same level or more. Its history moves with it; what it spent stays where it was spent.
conversation.noTargets: There is no other project to move it to.
conversation.deleteBody: Its messages are deleted. What it spent stays in its project's spending.
conversation.emptyTitle: What would you like to work on?
conversation.emptyBody: Ask a question, or describe what you need. Scholia answers in this conversation and remembers where you left off.
conversation.loadFailed: This conversation could not be loaded.
composer.label: Message
composer.hint: Enter to send · Shift+Enter for a new line
turn.revoked: The project changed during this run.
turn.limit: This conversation reached its budget. Raise it in Settings, then continue.
turn.unsaved: This answer was shown but could not be saved.
panel.libraryEmpty: Your papers and files will appear here.
setup.intro: A research assistant for reading, thinking and writing. It uses AI models through OpenRouter, with your own key.
setup.keyHelp: How do I get a key?
setup.otherProviders: Other providers can be added later in Settings.
setup.storeWarning: Your system's key store was unavailable, so the key is kept in a private file in Scholia's data folder.
settings.title: Settings
settings.backgroundRunsHint: Work Scholia does after an answer, such as titling a conversation.
settings.noRuns: Nothing has run in the background yet.
settings.dataFolderHint: Scholia keeps its database, files and settings here, readable only by your account.
folder.label: Folder
dataFolder.missing: Scholia was set to use a folder that is not there now. If it is on a disk that is not connected, connect the disk and open Scholia again, or choose another place.
dataFolder.foreign: The folder Scholia was set to use holds a database that is not Scholia's. Scholia left it unchanged; choose another place.
dataFolder.newer: The folder Scholia was set to use holds data from a newer version of Scholia. Update Scholia to open it, or choose another place.
dataFolder.unchecked: Scholia could not check the database in the folder it was set to use, so it left the folder unchanged. Make sure Scholia can read it and that this Mac has free space, then open Scholia again, or choose another place.
dataFolder.chooseHint: Choose an empty folder on this Mac that does not sync to the cloud. To keep your work, first move what is inside the old data folder into it in Finder, then choose it here.
dataFolder.chosen: Scholia will use this folder from the next time it opens. Close Scholia and open it again.
project.deleteBody: Its conversations, files and settings are deleted, with everything recorded about them.
delete.retention: Deleted data stays in Scholia's automatic backups until they are replaced: Scholia keeps 7 daily and 4 weekly backups, about five weeks if it runs every day. Delete everywhere replaces all of them, and any damaged database Scholia kept, with one new backup. Full backups and exports in your own folders are not changed.
delete.removeAllTraceHint: Scholia keeps a record that something was deleted, with its title. With this, the record keeps no title either.
delete.purgeFailed: It was deleted, but the older backups could not be replaced. They keep it until they are replaced in turn.
delete.stagingLeft: It was deleted, but a copy of earlier data that Scholia kept while restoring a backup could not be removed. Scholia tries again the next time it opens.
delete.filesLeft: It was deleted, but some of its files could not be removed. Scholia removes them the next time it opens.
backups.title: Backups
backups.hint: Scholia backs up its database and settings once a day and keeps 7 daily and 4 weekly backups in its data folder. They hold no files; a full backup does.
backups.fullHint: The database, your files and your settings, never your keys, in one zip file in a folder you choose. Settings Scholia does not recognize, and comments in settings files, are left out. Keep it on another disk.
backups.passphraseHint: Needed when a project is Private or Local only: the file is encrypted with it. Scholia cannot recover a lost passphrase.
backups.fromFileHint: A zip file a full backup wrote. Its files are added to Scholia's.
backups.passphraseRestoreHint: Only if the backup is encrypted.
backups.restoreBody: Scholia first saves its current state as a backup, stops any running work, then puts this backup in place. Anything done since is replaced; restore the saved copy to go back.
backups.restoreDamagedBody: Scholia moves the damaged database aside, keeping it with the backups, then puts this backup in place.
backups.restored: Restored. Scholia is running on the backup.
backups.notRecordedAudit: This restore could not be recorded in the audit log yet. Scholia records it the next time it opens.
backups.notRecordedMissingFiles: Scholia could not check whether every file it refers to is there.
backups.notRecordedJournal: Scholia finishes recording this restore the next time it opens.

backups.missingFiles.one: {count} file it refers to is missing.
backups.missingFiles.other: {count} files it refers to are missing.

backups.damagedBody: Scholia has not changed it. Restore a backup to continue; the damaged file is kept with the backups.
export.title: Export this project
export.hint: Its conversations as Markdown, its records as JSON, its files and its settings, never your keys, in one zip file anyone can open. Settings Scholia does not recognize, and comments in settings files, are left out.
export.passphraseHint: This project is Private or Local only, so its export is encrypted with this passphrase. Scholia cannot recover a lost passphrase.
errors.passphrase_required: A passphrase is needed: it holds a Private or Local only project, or it is encrypted.
errors.wrong_passphrase: The passphrase does not open this backup.
errors.backup_busy: Settings kept changing during the backup. Try again.
errors.database_damaged: Scholia's database is damaged. Restore a backup.
errors.database_unavailable: Scholia's database is not open right now. Try again in a moment.
errors.backup_failed: The backup could not be taken, so nothing else was done.
errors.write_failed: The file could not be written.
errors.destination_not_writable: Scholia cannot write to that folder. Choose another.
errors.destination_in_data_folder: Choose a folder outside Scholia's data folder.
errors.invalid_destination: Choose the folder by its full path.
errors.not_a_backup: That file is not a Scholia backup.
errors.backup_unreadable: That backup could not be read.
errors.newer_schema: That backup comes from a newer version of Scholia. Update Scholia to restore it.
errors.restore_failed: The backup could not be put in place. Nothing was changed.
errors.restore_interrupted: The restore was interrupted. Close Scholia and open it again to finish it.
errors.restoring: Scholia is restoring a backup. Try again when it has finished.
errors.work_running: Some running work did not stop in time, so nothing was restored. Try again in a moment.
errors.safety_copy_failed: Scholia could not first save its current state, so nothing was restored.
errors.data_folder_problem: Scholia has not opened its data folder.
errors.data_folder_synced: That folder syncs to the cloud or is on a network drive.
errors.data_folder_not_empty: Choose an empty folder, or one that already holds Scholia's data.
errors.data_folder_not_found: The folder that would hold it does not exist.
errors.data_folder_unsafe: Another account on this Mac could change that folder.
errors.data_folder_invalid: That folder cannot be used. Choose a folder by its full path.
errors.data_folder_foreign: That folder holds a database that is not Scholia's.
errors.data_folder_newer: That folder holds data from a newer version of Scholia.
errors.data_folder_unchecked: Scholia could not check the database in that folder.
errors.data_folder_not_writable: That folder is not yours, or Scholia cannot write in it.
errors.data_folder_record: Scholia cannot replace its note of where its data is, kept beside its default folder. Remove the item named “Scholia data folder.json” there, then choose again.
dataFolder.title: Scholia cannot use its data folder
dataFolder.synced: The data folder is inside a folder that syncs to the cloud or sits on a network drive, where its database could be damaged.
dataFolder.unsafe: Another account on this Mac could change what the data folder holds, so Scholia will not open it.
errors.unreachable: Scholia's engine is not responding. Close Scholia and open it again.
errors.active_run: This conversation is still working. Wait for it, or stop it.
errors.model_needed: Choose a model for this provider in Settings.
errors.no_provider: No model provider is set up yet.
errors.provider_key_missing: The provider has no key. Add it in Settings.
errors.unknown_provider: That provider is not set up.
errors.invalid_request: Something in the form is not valid.
errors.settings_changed: The settings changed meanwhile. Try again.
errors.conversation_moved: The conversation moved to another project. Send again.
errors.less_strict_project: A conversation can move only to a project protected at the same level or more.
errors.key_not_saved: The key could not be saved.
errors.general_project: The General project cannot be deleted, and stays Normal.
errors.session_required: This page is not Scholia's own window.
errors.network: The provider could not be reached.
errors.timeout: The provider took too long to answer.
errors.quota: The provider's account has run out of credit.
errors.rate_limit: The provider is limiting requests. Wait a moment and try again.
errors.malformed: The provider's answer could not be read.
errors.refused: This request is not allowed for this project.
errors.save_failed: The answer could not be saved.
errors.cancelled: The message was stopped before it was sent.
errors.invalid_effort: That effort level is not available.
errors.not_continuable: Only the latest stopped or interrupted answer can be continued.
settings.changedOnDisk: The settings file changed outside Scholia, so this change was not saved. It has been read again; make the change again if you still want it.
settings.followUp: While Scholia is working, a new message
settings.followUpHint: Steering reaches the agent at its next step. Waiting sends it as the next turn.
settings.conversationBudgetHint: Costs are estimates. At the budget, the step already running finishes and nothing new starts.
settings.personalInstructionsHint: Your AGENTS.md: read at the start of every conversation, in every project.
settings.projectInstructionsHint: This project's AGENTS.md, read after your own instructions.
settings.instructionsSize: {used} of {cap} KiB, with the other instructions
settings.instructionsOverCap: Together the instructions are over 32 KiB; only the first 32 KiB is used.
settings.projectLimitsHint: Leave a field empty to use your own setting.
settings.limitsHint: Within the budgets. A project can set its own.
settings.rolesHint: Leave a role empty to let Scholia choose.
roles.councilHint: One model, or several separated by commas.
roles.routerHint: Picks the model and effort when Auto is chosen.
roles.judgeHint: Checks that each cited passage supports its claim.
roles.extractorHint: Finds what to remember from your messages.
settings.localServersHint: A server such as Ollama or LM Studio is added as an endpoint under Providers and models, and declared there for use in Private and Local only projects.
helper.title: Local model helper
helper.hint: Scholia runs its search model on this Mac, in a helper program that starts when search needs it and stops once it has been idle. What it reads stays on this Mac.
helper.downloadCancelled: The download was cancelled. Nothing was installed.
helper.state.stopped: Not running. It starts when search needs it.
helper.searchHybrid: Search uses keywords and the search model.
helper.reason.model_missing: the search model is not installed. Download it, or import its file.
helper.reason.model_changed: the search model's file is not the expected one. Download or import it again.
helper.reason.binary_missing: the helper program is missing from this copy of Scholia. Reinstall Scholia.
helper.reason.binary_changed: the helper program changed since Scholia was built, so it is not started. Reinstall Scholia.
helper.reason.start_timeout: the helper did not start in time. Scholia tries again shortly.
helper.reason.start_failed: the helper could not start. Scholia tries again shortly.
helper.reason.crashed: the helper stopped unexpectedly. Scholia tries again shortly.
helper.reason.unhealthy: the helper stopped answering. Scholia tries again shortly.
helper.reason.helper_failed: the helper failed several times in a row. Choose Start again to try once more.
helper.reason.other: the helper is not available right now.
helper.reasonImport.model_missing: the search model is not installed. Import its file.
helper.reasonImport.model_changed: the search model's file is not the expected one. Import it again.
helper.consentBody: Scholia uses this model on this Mac to search your library by meaning as well as by keywords. Nothing from your projects is sent: the request only asks the source for this file.
helper.recommendModelScope: Hugging Face could not be reached, so ModelScope is recommended. Both serve the same file.
helper.consentNote: Scholia checks the file's size and SHA-256 before it uses it, and installs the file only if both match. The source you choose is remembered for next time.
helper.importHint: For a Mac without internet access: the file named {file}, from Hugging Face or ModelScope. Scholia installs it only if its size and SHA-256 match.
helper.localOnlyTitle: Search here is keyword-only for now
helper.localOnlyBody: Search in this project is keyword-only until the search model is installed or imported. A Local only project offers no download: import the model file under Settings, Advanced.
errors.source_unreachable: The source could not be reached. Try the other source, or import the file.
errors.source_refused: The source did not serve the file. Try again later, or try the other source.
errors.size_mismatch: The file's size is not the expected one, so it was not installed. Try again, try the other source, or import the file.
errors.hash_mismatch: The file's SHA-256 is not the expected one, so it was not installed. Try again, try the other source, or import the file.
errors.redirect_refused: The source sent the download on to a host Scholia does not allow, so nothing was downloaded. Try the other source, or import the file.
errors.download_refused: Scholia did not allow this download just now. Try again in a moment.
errors.download_interrupted: The download was interrupted. Try again.
errors.invalid_path: Name the file by its full path.
errors.file_not_found: There is no file at that path.
errors.not_a_file: That path is not a file.
errors.import_failed: The file could not be imported.
errors.local_only_no_download: A Local only project downloads nothing. Import the model file under Settings, Advanced.
errors.already_installed: The search model is already installed.
errors.download_running: A download or import is already under way.
errors.unknown_source: That source does not offer this model.
errors.download_failed: The download failed. Try again, try the other source, or import the file.
errors.notice_missing: This copy of Scholia is missing the model's license file, so the model was not installed. Reinstall Scholia.
providers.intro: Connect a provider first, then choose its models. Keys are kept in your system's key store, never in a settings file.
providers.addHint: For another provider, or a model server on this Mac. Scholia sends requests only to this address.
providers.name: Name
providers.addressHint: https, or http on this Mac only.
providers.keyHint: A local server that asks for no key accepts any text, such as local.
providers.replaceKey: Paste a new key to replace it
providers.defaultWindowHint: Used for models that report none, and as a cap. At least 4,096.
providers.perModel: Each model's window, effort and price
providers.windowTrust: Scholia relies on a window you set and cannot verify it. A setting can lower a reported window, never raise it.
subagents.modelsHint: Up to five, in order of preference. The agent picks from this list for each task, then falls back to the first, then to the conversation's model. Models this project's level does not allow are skipped.
subagents.empty: Empty: subagents use the conversation's model.
subagents.effortCapHint: minimal, low, medium, high or xhigh.
project.venueHint: Where the work is headed, such as a journal.
project.citationStyleHint: Empty: chosen from the manuscript's language.
project.budgetHint: Everything in the project counts toward it.
picker.label: Model: {model}
picker.autoHint: Scholia picks the model and effort for each request
picker.none: No models match. Providers and models are set in Settings.
effort.label: Effort
effort.unknownHint: This model's effort steps are not checked yet, so it runs at its own default.
errors.window_too_small: A window is at least 4,096 tokens.
settings.problemValue: Line {line}: {key} is not valid, so its default is used.
settings.problemFile: The settings file is not valid at line {line}, so the defaults are used.
settings.problemFileUnread: The settings file could not be read, so the defaults are used.
picker.setWindow: Set the window of {model} to use it
settings.instructionsReplaced: This file is not UTF-8 text. Some characters could not be read and are shown as �; saving it replaces them for good.
errors.model_not_offered: That model is not offered for this provider. Choose it under Providers and models, or pick another.
errors.model_window: That model has no usable context window. Set one under Providers and models, or pick another model.
errors.refresh_failed: The provider's model list could not be read. Check its connection, then try again.
settings.instructionsUnreadable: This file could not be read, so it cannot be edited here. Check its permissions in the data folder.
protection.question: What will this project hold?
protection.ownHint: Any model you set up may be used.
protection.private: Unpublished work or personal data, such as interview transcripts
protection.privateHint: Private: only OpenRouter's zero-retention models, and model servers on this Mac that you declared.
protection.review: Someone else's submission, for peer review
protection.reviewHint: Review lock: kept on this Mac, and Scholia's AI help is off in this project.
protection.venue: Journal or funder of the submission
protection.venuePlaceholder: Optional; an unknown venue is treated as the strictest
protection.title: What this project holds
protection.hint: A stricter answer applies at once and stops work running in this project. A less strict one asks first. Every change is recorded in the audit log.
protection.applying: Applying. A backup or export being written without a passphrase stops first, so this can take a moment.
protection.localOnlyNow: Only models on this Mac are used. Choose an answer above to change that.
protection.lockFirst: Lift the review lock before choosing a less strict answer.
protection.loosen.normal: From now on, this project's text may go to any model you set up, including providers that keep data.
protection.loosen.private: From now on, this project's text may go to OpenRouter's zero-retention models, as well as to declared servers on this Mac.
protection.unlockBody: Scholia's AI help comes back in this project. It stays Local only until you change that too.
protection.generalNote: The General project is for anything outside a project, and stays Normal. Create a project for private work.
privacy.key.intro: For a Private project, OpenRouter's settings for this key, in your account or organization and in its workspace, must keep this key's prompts and responses out of OpenRouter's three opt-in data features, and add no plugin to its requests:
privacy.key.logging: Input & Output Logging is off, or excludes this key.
privacy.key.improvement: The setting that lets OpenRouter use inputs and outputs to improve its product is off.
privacy.key.broadcast: Broadcast sends no content from this key: it is off, it excludes this key, or every destination that receives this key's traces uses Privacy Mode.
privacy.key.plugins: No plugin is enabled by default for your account or organization in OpenRouter's plugin settings.
privacy.key.unverifiable: Scholia cannot check these settings: an ordinary key cannot read them. It records your confirmation in the audit log, and asks again in six months, when the key changes, or when this statement changes.
privacy.local.statement: This server runs its models on this Mac, and passes no request on to another service.
privacy.local.unverifiable: Scholia cannot verify this, and a relay to a cloud model would break it. Your declaration is recorded in the audit log.
privacy.local.private: For a Private project, this is your own assurance, not a retention guarantee like OpenRouter's zero retention.
keyConfirm.title: Use in Private projects
keyConfirm.status.missing: Not confirmed: Private projects refuse this key.
keyConfirm.status.other_key: Not confirmed for this key: Private projects refuse it.
keyConfirm.status.expired: The confirmation has expired: Private projects refuse this key.
keyConfirm.status.outdated: This statement changed since you confirmed it: Private projects refuse this key.
keyConfirm.observabilityLink: Logging and Broadcast settings on OpenRouter
localDeclare.title: A model server on this Mac
localDeclare.declared: Declared {date}: Private and Local only projects may use it.
localDeclare.undeclared: Not declared: Private and Local only projects do not use it.
allowlist.title: Private allowlist
allowlist.hint: The OpenRouter routes Private projects may use. Every request also carries OpenRouter's zero-retention flag. Shipped entries were checked against OpenRouter's terms on {date}.
allowlist.every: Every OpenRouter model with a zero-retention endpoint
allowlist.stale: Checked over six months ago, so it may be out of date.
allowlist.exception.plugins_and_tools: Zero retention covers model requests only, not plugins or server tools. Scholia sends none. Your key's account must also enable no plugin by default: you confirm this with the key's data settings, and Scholia cannot check it.
allowlist.exception.in_memory_caching: OpenRouter does not count in-memory prompt caching as retention.
allowlist.exception.key_data_settings: Your key's data settings must also be confirmed, under Providers and models.
allowlist.addPlaceholder: A model id, such as vendor/model
allowlist.addHint: An entry for one model comes before the entry for every model: turn it off to keep that model out.
audit.title: Audit log
audit.hint: What Scholia decided and changed: requests allowed or refused, changes to protection and keys, deletions and exports. It never holds your content.

audit.sent.one: {count} request from this project was allowed to leave this Mac, as far as this log goes.
audit.sent.other: {count} requests from this project were allowed to leave this Mac, as far as this log goes.

audit.clearBody: Every entry is deleted. A record that the log was cleared stays, and so does each record of a Delete everywhere that replaced the backups.
picker.protected.private: Private project: only zero-retention OpenRouter models and declared servers on this Mac are shown.
picker.protected.local_only: Local only project: only declared servers on this Mac are shown.
picker.protected.locked: Review-locked project: Scholia's AI help is off.
errors.review_locked: This project is review-locked, so Scholia's AI help is off in it.
errors.route_not_allowed: This project's protection does not allow that model. Pick another, such as one on a declared server on this Mac.
errors.private_route_not_allowed: Private projects use only OpenRouter models with a zero-retention endpoint on the Private allowlist. Pick another.
errors.not_declared: That server on this Mac is not declared yet. Declare it under Providers and models.
errors.key_not_confirmed: Confirm your OpenRouter key's data settings under Providers and models before using it in a Private project.
errors.project_changed: The project's protection changed meanwhile. Try again.
errors.statement_changed: The statement changed. Read it again, then confirm.
errors.not_openrouter: Only an OpenRouter key is confirmed here.
errors.not_local: Only a server on this Mac can be declared.
errors.not_openrouter_route: Only OpenRouter models can be added.
audit.reason.credential_to_non_provider: a credential to a host that is not a provider
audit.reason.not_general_project: a download outside the General project
audit.reason.route_not_allowed: model not on the Private allowlist
audit.reason.revoked: the run was told to stop
audit.reason.local_server_not_yours: server not run by your account
audit.field.remove_all_trace: title left out of the record
errors.target_changed: The server's address changed since it was shown. Check it, then declare it again.
errors.key_changed: The key changed since it was shown. Read the statement again, then confirm.
errors.export_failed: The audit log could not be written to the data folder.
